name: linkedin-crm-sync
description: Reads your LinkedIn inbox, matches conversation participants against accounts assigned to you in the shared Notion All Accounts CRM, cross-checks Salesforce and your calendar, summarizes those conversations into Conversation Hub, and — only on your explicit go-ahead in chat — sends LinkedIn messages. Works for every rep on the team, each on their own LinkedIn login. Scoped to inbox + existing connections only; no people/company/job search.
